function: SAC learns BS beamforming and STAR-RIS coefficients, DDQN learns UAV hovering position, to maximize clients admitted to over-the-air FL aggregation under an MSE limit (p. 1, 3).
system: BS with M=6 antennas, K single-antenna clients, UAV-mounted STAR-RIS with N=30 elements (energy splitting, coupled phase shifts), LoS ULAs; carrier frequency not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: Reinforcement learning: SAC (continuous beamforming and RIS actions) plus DDQN (discrete UAV positions) under one shared reward; FedAvg trains the CNN being aggregated (p. 2-4).
data_channel: Custom simulated LoS channel (ULA array responses, path-loss exponents 3 and 2.2); CNN on MNIST for the FL task; no standard or measured channel (p. 2, 4-5).
test_conditions: Training and test conditions not separated: one simulated setting (M=6, N=30, clients in two fixed regions); curves swept over MSE requirement kappa and total clients K (p. 4-5).
baselines: Ideal-AirFL (all clients, no error), IPS, CPS, CRIS, R-Phase (random STAR-RIS coefficients, SAC beamformer), random UAV position; no earlier published aggregation design or other learned method (p. 4-5).
metrics: Number of participating clients versus MSE requirement and versus K; FL prediction accuracy (CNN, MNIST) versus aggregation rounds and MSE requirement (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "modeled via their respective array responses" - the paper defines its own LoS ULA channel and sets path-loss parameters itself (p. 4); it names no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 5: "versus the total number of clients K" - only a sweep over K and the MSE requirement in one simulated setup; the paper never states a test on an unseen scenario, band or K, nor whether agents are retrained per K.
q3_support: p. 5: "The STAR-RIS coefficients are randomly generated, and the BS beamforming is optimized using SAC" - all baselines (p. 4-5) are variants or self-defined heuristics of the proposed method; no earlier published aggregation design or independent learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 4: "lightweight and computationally efficient" - only a qualitative remark about DDQN; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime is reported for the method.
q5_support: p. 5: "We use a CNN model on the MNIST dataset" - MNIST is a public dataset of the learning task alone; the channel is a custom simulation (p. 2) and no code or data link or DOI is given.
notes: Area 7 over area 3: the problem solved is over-the-air aggregation itself, since beamforming, STAR-RIS and client count serve the aggregation MSE limit (p. 1-3). UAV placement is learned jointly with the physical-layer decision, so above_phy does not apply. Carrier frequency not stated.
